article.name: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Employers
article.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Employers
article.body:
General Questions

What is the link for Employer e-Services?

Link to Employer e-Services

Where can we access the recorded Webinars?

Link to Recorded Webinars

Do TNPAWs log in credentials work in Employer e-Services?

No, TNPAWS logins will not work on Employer e-Services. If you have not already, you will need to sign up for an Online Account on Employer e-Services (Link to Employer e-Services) after May 27 in order to access UI Tax functionality.

Does this mean every employer will sign up again or use their existing sign in?

Existing employers that have not signed up for an online account in Employer e-Services will need to do so in order to access UI Tax functionality.

Will you need a verification code every time you login?

No, you will not need to enter a verification code each time you log in.

With the online registration process, will the Department instantly assign the EAN to the employer?

Yes!  New employers will receive their account number and rate immediately after completing the registration process.

What if we sent application for employer number prior to the shutdown, but haven't received it yet?

We will continue to process paper applications that were received prior to the upgrade. You can wait to receive a letter in the mail and sign up for your web logon at that time or you can register your business on or after May 27 on Home - Employer e-Services and receive your account number instantly and avoid the wait.

For employers with a household employee only, will they need to register here?

Yes. Every employing unit in Tennessee, regardless of the number of workers, is required to complete this form to determine the status of their liability for unemployment insurance in Tennessee. 

Do Reimbursing employers follow a different process at any point?

The process of filing reports and navigating the new system is very similar for both taxpaying and reimbursing employers.

Will this change effect tntap.com at all?

No, TNTAP is an application that is administered by a different Agency (Department of Revenue). 

Does this new website handle New Hire forms? Is New Hire reporting changing?

No, this system does not handle new hires. The TN New Hire Reporting Program is administered by the TN Department of Human Services.

Account Access

I am already registered on Employer e-Services. Will I need to do anything different in order to access UI Tax functionality?

No. Existing Employer e-Services users that have full access will be able to access UI Tax information with the same logon credentials starting May 27, 2025. Logons with Administrator access will need to update their access level to Employer full access to see UI Tax functionality.

How do I log in as a TPA? I don't see that option anywhere.

TPAs and Employers login with the same login panel on Employer e-Services.

What is benefits access?

There are two types of access available to users in Employer e-Services. Benefit Access grants permissions to respond to unemployment claims. Tax Access allows users to file and/or pay wage and premium reports.  Employers may grant their workers one or both types of access to e-Services.

If you signed up for an ex-employee wanting benefits or for an employee claim, does that count as your sign in to pay unemployment on your quarterlies?

Yes. Your Employer e-Services account used for benefits is the same system. Tax functionality will be made available on May 27, 2025.

If you are an employer with more than one employer account with TN, can you access all your UI accounts under the same login?

Yes, if you manage more than one UI account in TN you may request for access to multiple accounts under the same logon.

If our account is currently inactive, what is the best practice to re-activate?

You may request to reactivate your closed account via Employer e-Services on or after May 27, 2025. If you don’t have access to your online account, sign up on Employer e-Services on Home - Employer e-Services by clicking the Sign up for an Online Account link. From the home page of your logged in session, view the Summary tab and click the Employer Services link on the Employer Information panel. Then click the Additional Services tab and view the UI Tax Account Maintenance section to request to reactivate your account by clicking the Reinstate Unemployment Insurance Tax Account link.

Can we assign administrator access to a team member based outside of US?

Only users in the United States and Canada can access Employer e-Services.

Will clients' TPA access default to “no” like IL does? Or will it default to “yes”?

In Employer e-Services, TPA access will default to Yes.

What Letter ID do I need to obtain online access to my UI Tax information in Employer e-Services on or after May 27?

Prior to May 23, 2025, if you received a letter from the TN Department of Labor's UI Benefits agency within the last year, you may use the Letter ID located in the top right of this letter to complete your web logon registration. If you have not received a letter from the TN Department of Labor's UI Benefits agency in the past year, you may request an access letter via the web logon registration itself. Letters requested in this way will be delivered to your mailing address on file in the current system within three to four business days.

Letter requests for registering a web logon will be available on or after May 27, 2025.

How does a CPA receive a POA number to register as a third party administrator?

Prior to May 23, 2025, POA numbers were assigned internally. If you represent employers in benefit matters, you have a number available. You may contact us at ui.services@tn.gov for the number. If you only represent employers in tax matters, you will need to register in e-Services on May 27, 2025.

On or after May 27, 2025, POA numbers will no longer be required to register as a third-party administrator.

I am not a CPA or accountant, but I am in charge of payroll. My boss owns multiple businesses that I do payroll and UI reports for. Is it best for me to submit them separately or will I be able to submit them all together now?

You will create one logon and from there you can add additional UI accounts to manage.

Designated Access

If I file my firm's UI report, will my employees be able to access it while filing our client UI reports? Are we able to set up separate access for our employees?

You may setup multiple web logons for one TN employer account or have one logon to manage multiple accounts (if applicable).

Do business owners and their bookkeepers have different log in accounts?

Not necessarily.  You may set your bookkeeper up with a web logon or your bookkeeper may set up their own logon and add their clients.

Are we limited to one login per employer? I tried to register and couldn't because our HR manager has a login.

There can be multiple logons allowed for an employer. The first person who registers a customer is known as a primary logon. They are automatically given Master access to the customer and are able to create secondary logons and assign the access type (Administrator, Account Manager or Third-Party Administrator) for each one. There is only ever one primary logon for a given customer.

Can one person have only benefit claims and nothing else? For our HR side.

On the logged in e-Services homepage, click the More… tab. View the Access Management panel and click the Manage link. Click the link of the logon you want to manage the access for. Click the link in the Access level field and select UI Benefits in the dropdown menu. 

What if payments are managed by someone differently who manages employees and termination?

Each logon can have different levels of access. Payments are under Tax access which would be File and Pay or Pay Only, and managing employees and termination would fall only Benefits Access.

On the logged in e-Services homepage, click the More… tab. View the Access Management panel and click the Manage link. Click the link of the logon you want to manage the access for. Then click the link in the Access level field and select ‘UI Benefits Only’ in the dropdown menu for those that manage employees and termination, and ‘UI Tax File and Pay’ or ‘UI Tax Pay Only’.

Account Information

Will we lose our history from TNPAWS?

No.  Wages, rates and other information from 2019 through the current quarter will be available on e-Services.

Account Maintenance

Can I make changes to an account without having to send a form up and it never getting processed?

There are many self-service account maintenance web requests available in Employer e-Services. From your logged in session on the e-Services homepage:

  • On the [default] Summary tab, view the Employer Information panel and click the Employer Services link. Then click the Additional Services tab for requests including but not limited to reinstating an account, managing contacts, file a charge protest and request a subpoena.
  • Click the More… tab for requests such as updating names and addresses and applying for a payment agreement.

Note: Most of the requests will process automatically - only a select few based on what is being requested needs review and approval from the department.

Wage Reporting

Can we still file on TNPAWS or Third-Party Upload (TPU)?

No. Wage reports will be filed by logging into Employer e-Services on May 27, 2025. TNPAWS and TPU are no longer available to file wage reports.

Can the info still be input manually?

Yes, you may enter employee wage information directly into the system or by uploading a file using one of our three text file types. 

Will the employees’ information carry over each quarter or will we need to enter SSN and name each quarter?

Employee names and SSNs from the prior quarter will carry over to subsequent reports.

Is the taxable wage base changing?

No, taxable base is not changing with the new system rollout. Current taxable limit is $7000 per employee.

With this new portal, we can submit amendments forms, too? If we need to make a SS corrections?

Yes, all amendments will be done through the system.  All paper amendment forms have been removed from the website and will not be accepted in the near future since the expectation is that amendments to wage reports are to be done in the system.

Will this system allow us to file a "missed" report, at least through amendments or something?

Yes, you will be able to file delinquent quarters through the new system. You can file any reports that are needed through the system. There just won’t be a delinquent section like TNPAWS. In addition, even if a quarter is assessed a tax value, you can still file the late report, and policy will determine whether or not the report will override the assessed tax due.

Can you print a copy of the actual report?

You can print a summary of the wage report but not the actual report. (This may change in the future.)

What happens when we owe less than $5.00 in an unemployment quarterly tax return?

You will still need to file and pay. However, Tennessee will not bill for amounts less than $1.00.

So, the point of this is merging what we used to do in SIDES and TNPAWS into one site?

This is the final step to fully modernizing Tennessee’s UI System. 

If you are registered with SIDES, you will be able to receive electronic communications regarding benefit claim activity from the agency via the SIDES E-Response web site.

From the logged in e-Services homepage on the [default] Summary tab, view the Employer Information panel and click the Employer Services link. Then click the Additional Services tab where you will be able to enroll in, review, and manage your account's SIDES enrollment.

Once we register, can we also set up quick books to auto file?

For QuickBooks users, it will depend on your QuickBooks setup and how you file reports.

File Formats

Is the format the same as it was with the TNPAWS upload? Is the file format still a 58-character text file?

We will continue accepting the same file formats in the new system. Text file formats will be the same in Employer e-Services. 

The new system accepts three file formats, one of which is the 58-character format. 

For the Error listing, will the EAN also be listed, or will it only be the line #?

Only the line # will be listed on the screen in e-Services. You can also export them to a spreadsheet for better visibility of all errors.

Payments

How do you make a payment once you've filed the quarterly wage report?

From the logged in e-Services homepage on the [default] Summary tab, view the Account panel and click the Make a Payment link. Then follow the prompts to submit a payment. 

Are payments and filing completed at the same time?

You may file and pay at the same time, or separately.

Can you mail in a payment?

Online payments are preferred and more secure, but you will have the option to pay by paper check.

Bank Information

Will banking information roll into the new system?

No banking information is being brought from TNPAWS into Employer e-Services. It will have to be reentered.  Once reentered, you will be given the option to save it for future use.   

Will the bank account info that is saved in TNTAP be communicated over to this TN SUI System?

TNTAP is not affiliated with TDLWD Employer e-Services.  You will need to add payment account information on Employer e-Services separately from TNTAP.

Can you limit a third party from viewing your payment account information?

TPAs will not be able to view your (business) personal payment information.

Only users granted UI Tax Access will have access to bank account information saved in the system. 

Refunds

How do I request a refund for overpayment?

Refund requests will be through the system if the account is available to get one.

Additional Questions

How do we file a separation notice? Will we be able to input separation notices in the new system?

[UI Benefits only] Separation notices are requirements to provide to the employee that is being separated. The Department only needs a response to separation if there is a claim filed, and your company is the separating employer.
